comment: The 162-entry fixture appended twice produces 324 entries, full tiles and deleted width-162 partial paths. The checkpoint is served's unchanged signed and cosigned head at 162. Apply each addition, replacement or deletion over this directory; the case with no mutation accepts it as served.

corrupt-beyond-prefix.says: only its first `W` hashes or entries are then used

corrupt-within-prefix.says: compared with the tree it rebuilt exactly as the partial path would have been

full-bundle-gone.says: `unserved` only when neither the partial path nor the full one is served

full-tile-gone.says: `unserved` only when neither the partial path nor the full one is served

full-tile-trailing-bytes.says: a longer or shorter one is `tiles` (step 12)

full-tile-truncated.says: a longer or shorter one is `tiles` (step 12)

malformed-partial-with-good-full.says: a served hash tile disagrees with the rebuilt tree
